messages:
alex: Quick FYI — planned deploy for routing-service tonight 00:30 UTC (small config change: new routing policy). Rolling restarts across 3 pods, canary at 10% for 10m then 50% for 5m, then 100%.

sam: Ack — I'll take handoff. Oncall coverage: me + lisa for rollback/watchers. ping @lisa

lisa: here, thanks. Any freeze window? I'm OOO from 02:00-06:00 UTC so if rollback needed ping maria.

alex: Freeze window 00:15–00:45 UTC for DB schema migrations? Actually none for this deploy — config-only. Still recommend minimal traffic during canary.

tom: Smoke test checklist below — will run after canary.
```
# smoke tests
curl -f https://routing.service/health || exit 1
curl -f https://routing.service/api/v1/ping || exit 1
kubectl logs -n prod routing-service --tail 100 | grep "started"
```

infra-bot: Deploy schedule recorded: routing-service:v2.9.1 -> canary 10% (00:30-00:40) -> ramp. Autoscaling: paused during rollout. Link: http://grafana.company/d/routing-rollout

deploy-bot: Rollout watchers: @sam @lisa @maria. Alert policy: p99 latency > 600ms for 5m -> pager.

sam: Noted — I'll watch latency and error-rate. Manual rollback plan: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/routing-service -n prod` and then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress -n prod` if needed.

lisa: Also watch cache warmup — expect a small spike in token fetches. If p50 latency rises > 200ms, consider pausing ramp.

maria: I can be on-call backup 00:45-03:00 UTC in case you need hands.

alex: Thanks. Post-deploy verification: run tom's smoke tests + confirm no error spike in logs, and verify KV cache hit ratio -> grafana panel. I'll update on finish.

sam: Will post a short summary once done. :thumbsup:

maria: GL everyone :rocket:
